name: Memory Bandwidth Utilization
summary: Measure achieved memory bandwidth during a benchmark and compare it against the GPU's theoretical maximum bandwidth
purpose: Measure achieved memory bandwidth during a benchmark and compare it against the GPU's theoretical maximum bandwidth. Calculate utilization percentage.
assignment_instructions: You are calculating memory bandwidth utilization for a GPU benchmark. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_memory_bandwidth_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - gpu_model (string) - benchmark_name (string) - achieved_bandwidth_gbps (number): measured memory bandwidth in GB/s - theoretical_max_bandwidth_gbps (number): GPU spec memory bandwidth in GB/s - memory_bandwidth_utilization (number between 0 and 1): achieved / theoretical_max - memory_bandwidth_utilization_percent (number): memory_bandwidth_utilization * 100 - utilization_sufficient (boolean): memory_bandwidth_utilization >= 0.50 - bandwidth_deficit_gbps (number): theoretical_max - achieved Compute memory_bandwidth_utilization exactly as achieved_bandwidth_gbps / theoretical_max_bandwidth_gbps. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include the formula in calculations array. If theoretical_max_bandwidth_gbps is missing, report it in missing_inputs and set utilization fields to null. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: utilization_sufficient must be true when utilization >= 50%
Both bandwidth values must be positive numbers

math_checks.description: Fraction of theoretical memory bandwidth achieved
Difference between theoretical and achieved bandwidth

evidence_checks.description: Must be from actual benchmark measurement
Must be from official GPU specification sheet

flag_rules.description: Memory bandwidth utilization is between 50% and 70%
Memory bandwidth utilization is 70% or above
